svg.title: EvidenceGraph — Advanced RAG and Knowledge Retrieval
svg.desc: Offline ingestion: document parsing, semantic chunking, dense embeddings, BM25 sparse encoding, and entity/claim extraction into Qdrant and Neo4j. Online retrieval: query expansion, dense retrieval, BM25, graph traversal, reciprocal rank fusion, reranking, context assembly, and grounded evidence to LangGraph.
